Northwind Software - Employee Policy Handbook v4.1
Page 7
Remote Work
Northwind follows a hybrid model. Employees work from the office on at least 3 days a week,
and can work from home on the other days.
Who can work remotely
Remote work is available to employees who have completed probation. Some roles, such as
reception and IT support, need to be in the office every day.
Working from another city
You can work from another city in India for up to 4 weeks a year, with your manager's
approval. Working from outside India is not allowed because of tax and data rules.
Home setup
The company pays a one-time home office allowance of Rs 15,000 for a chair, desk or screen,
and Rs 1,000 per month for internet.
Being available
When working remotely, you must be reachable on the team chat and phone during core hours
and join meetings with your camera on when asked.
